description: This file is an entry server implementation for a Remix web application, handling HTTP requests, rendering React components server-side, and managing responses with support for bot detection and streaming.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, detects bots, and routes the request to either handleBotRequest or handleBrowserRequest.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user agents, sending streamed HTML content.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user agents, sending streamed HTML content.
